issues.detail: The Greek 'τον επιουσιον' (the necessary/daily bread) describes the nature of the bread, whereas the Vietnamese 'đủ ngày' (enough for the day) changes the attribute from 'necessary' to a quantity. Furthermore, 'hôm nay' (today) is used in Vietnamese, but the Greek 'το καθ ημεραν' means 'for each day' (daily).
